name: Exp_ColorZerolagTriX
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the ColorZerolagTriX custom indicator, which is a zero-lag weighted combination of five TriX (Triple Exponential Moving Average) oscillators. It opens buy positions when the fast oscillator crosses above the slow one and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagTriX自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标是五个TriX（三重指数移动平均）振荡器的零滞后加权组合。当快速振荡器上穿慢速振荡器时开多仓，反之开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于零滞后TriX振荡器的交叉信号，通过五个不同周期（8、21、34、55、89）的TriX加权组合来消除滞后性，产生更及时的趋势反转信号。入场条件为：当快速线Osc1从下方上穿慢速线Osc2时产生买入信号，当Osc1从上方下穿Osc2时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），以及基于反向交叉信号的主动平仓机制。仓位管理采用基于保证金比例（MM=0.1）或固定手数两种模式，通过MMMode参数切换。资金管理方面，止损止盈比例为1:2，风险回报比较为合理，但缺少基于波动率的动态仓位调整。信号仅在新区块出现时计算，避免重复交易，且使用SignalBar参数控制信号延迟。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on crossover signals from a zero-lag TriX oscillator, which combines five TriX oscillators with different periods (8, 21, 34, 55, 89) using weighted factors to eliminate lag and produce more timely trend reversal signals. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the fast line Osc1 crosses above the slow line Osc2, and a sell signal is generated when Osc1 crosses below Osc2. Exit conditions include fixed pip-based stop loss (1000 pips) and take profit (2000 pips), as well as an active position closing mechanism based on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing uses either a margin-based ratio (MM=0.1) or fixed lot mode, switchable via the MMMode parameter. In terms of money management, the stop loss to take profit ratio is 1:2, which provides a reasonable risk-reward ratio, but there is no volatility-based dynamic position sizing. Signals are only calculated on new bars to avoid repeated trading, and the SignalBar parameter controls signal delay for confirmation.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（固定手数或保证金比例）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: fixed lot or margin percentage

pros: 零滞后TriX组合有效减少传统移动平均线的滞后性，信号更及时
使用五个不同周期（斐波那契数列8-89）的TriX加权组合，多层次捕捉趋势变化
止损止盈比1:2，风险回报比合理，且有反向交叉信号主动平仓机制
新区块检测机制避免同一信号重复交易，降低过度交易风险
买卖开平仓可独立控制，灵活性高
pros_en: Zero-lag TriX combination effectively reduces the lag of traditional moving averages, producing more timely signals
Uses five TriX oscillators with Fibonacci-based periods (8-89) and weighted factors for multi-layered trend detection
Stop loss to take profit ratio of 1:2 provides a reasonable risk-reward ratio, with active closing on reverse crossover signals
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading on the same signal, reducing overtrading risk
Buy/sell open and close controls are independently configurable, offering high flexibility
cons: 固定止损1000点和止盈2000点不适应不同波动率市场，低波动时止损过大，高波动时止损过小
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大的品种上可能产生虚假信号或不合理的入场
没有持仓检查和重复订单保护，可能在同一信号上重复开仓
依赖自定义指标ColorZerolagTriX，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
没有移动止损或追踪止损机制，无法在盈利头寸上锁定浮动利润
cons_en: Fixed stop loss of 1000 pips and take profit of 2000 pips do not adapt to varying market volatility—too wide in low volatility and too tight in high volatility
No spread filter, which may lead to false signals or unreasonable entries on instruments with wide spreads
No position check or duplicate order protection, potentially opening multiple positions on the same signal
Depends on the custom indicator ColorZerolagTriX—the EA cannot run if the indicator file is missing
No trailing stop mechanism to lock in floating profits on winning positions
improvements: 添加基于ATR的动态止损止盈，使风险管理适应市场波动率变化
增加持仓检查和重复信号过滤，防止同一信号重复开仓；添加点差过滤避免高点差环境下的不利入场
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt risk management to changing market volatility
Add position check and duplicate signal filtering to prevent repeated entries on the same signal; add spread filter to avoid unfavorable entries in high-spread environments

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查，可能在同一信号上重复开仓导致仓位叠加风险
固定止损不适应市场波动率变化，极端行情下可能产生超出预期的亏损
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to repeated entries on the same signal, causing position accumulation risk
Fixed stop loss does not adapt to market volatility changes, potentially causing larger-than-expected losses in extreme market conditions
